summary.text: Tyrone Evans is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 128 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Trey Sheppard for an open seat.
An accountant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifelong Baldwin County resident and a certified public accountant.

paragraphs.text: Tyrone Evans graduated from Baldwin High School, earned an associate degree from Georgia Military College in 1989, and later earned graduate degrees from Georgia College & State University in 2001 and Fort Valley State University in 2023.
His career experience includes working as an accountant.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Evans said he first aspired to run for office at age 27 and ran unsuccessfully twice before pausing that pursuit, and that for twenty years he has gone to the Georgia State Capitol each year to advocate for behavioral health.
He listed experience in healthcare leadership, banking and public-education finance, and board service with the Development Authority, the hospital board, Big Brothers Big Sisters and 100 Black Men.
He named financial responsibility, rural infrastructure improvement and healthcare advocacy among his priorities, and listed Fair Fight Action and Floyd Griffin as endorsers.
